roster.description: A human berserker in scale mail with a halberd, and a spare on her back.

sheet.stats: Human · STR 17 DEX 14 CON 14 · Speed 30 ft

features.name: Halberd
features.text: +5, 1d10+3 slashing. Heavy, reach 10 ft, two-handed. Mastery: Cleave.

features.name: Cleave
features.text: After a melee hit on her turn: one free attack on a second creature within 5 ft of the first and within reach, without her ability modifier on the damage. Once per turn.

features.name: Rage
features.text: Bonus action, three uses: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, +2 damage with Strength attacks, Advantage on Strength checks and saves, no spells. It lasts until the end of her next turn; attacking an enemy, or a bonus action, keeps it going. It ends if she is Incapacitated.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.text: Before her first attack roll on her turn: Advantage on Strength attack rolls until her next turn, but attack rolls against her have Advantage too.

features.name: Frenzy
features.text: Path of the Berserker: while raging and reckless, the first creature she hits with a Strength attack on her turn takes an extra 2d6.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.text: Advantage on Dexterity saves unless Incapacitated.

features.name: Savage Attacker
features.text: Once per turn, roll a weapon hit's damage dice twice and keep the higher total.

features.name: Alert
features.text: Add your proficiency bonus to initiative.
